public class CheckStyle {
    private static final String CHECKSTYLE_CONFIG_FILE = "checkstyle.xml";
    private static final String CHECKSTYLE_REPORT_FILE = "checkstyle-report.html";

    public void runCheckStyle() {
        try {
            File configFile = new File(CHECKSTYLE_CONFIG_FILE);
            if (!configFile.exists()) {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Checkstyle configuration file not found");
            }

            File reportFile = new File(CHECKSTYLE_REPORT_FILE);
            if (reportFile.exists()) {
                reportFile.delete();
            }

            ProcessBuilder processBuilder = new ProcessBuilder(
                    "java", "-jar", "checkstyle-all.jar", configFile.getAbsolutePath(), reportFile.getAbsolutePath()
            );
            processBuilder.redirectErrorStream(true);

            Process process = processBuilder.start();
            int exitCode = process.waitFor();

            if (exitCode != 0) {
                throw new IOException("Checkstyle execution failed with exit code " + exitCode);
            }
        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

    public void runCheckStyle() {
        try {
            // Load configuration file
            FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(CHECKSTYLE_CONFIG_FILE);
            Properties properties = new Properties();
            properties.load(fis);
            fis.close();

            // Create a Checker instance

            checker.configure(properties);

            // Set up output stream for report

            checker.addListener(writer);

            // Perform the check

            // Close resources
            writer.close();
            fos.close();
        } catch (IOException | ConfigurationException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

    }
